In addition, the low concentrations of Mn in InAs phase and small volume of the (In,Mn)As phase could be beyond the limits of detection using our MFM. In the future, the growth conditions of (In,Mn)As shell need to be optimized in order to be able to successfully grow single phase (In,Mn)As shell on InAs nanowires to develop the understanding of nanoscale magnetism in DMS materials.
